messages:
sam: Morning check-in — quick standup:
Did: finished SLO dashboard for prefix-cache and fixed aggregation bug in the prometheus query.
Blockers: spike in 5xxs on /v1/generate during long tails, haven't traced root cause yet.
Today: correlate traces and disable the new batching experiment if it looks like the culprit. @lina @eugene FYI.

lina: Looks like the spike lines up with the `kv-evict` cron at ~03:10 UTC. Saw GC pauses on nodes `gpu-pool-3`. I pushed a temp throttle to the cron in staging to validate. :thinking: Could be memory pressure from continuous batching + evictions.

eugene: I ran a few query windows — traces show a bunch of `kv_lookup` retries/timeouts ~200-300ms. Clients sometimes give up and surface 5xx.
Logging snippet:
```
2025-08-14T03:11:58Z WARN kv_lookup retry=3 duration=312ms key=... node=gpu-pool-3
```
I'll open a quick PR to lower `retry` to 1 for the hot path and add a metric for `kv_retry_count`.
PR: https://git.redwood/infra/kv-cache/pulls/142

sam: Nice. Can we also re-evaluate alert thresholds? Current alert `slo:latency_p95` fires at 750ms which may be too tight during batch ramps. @oncall-bot any recent PAGE events?

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-0423 — high error rate on /v1/generate (triggered at 2025-08-14T03:12:07Z). PagerDuty notified. Runbook: https://docs.redwood/runbooks/generate-5xx

dan: I toggled the canary to fallback model last night; we should make fallback policy automatic when >2% 5xx for 5m. I can sketch an automated rollout policy in the console if folks agree.

lina: Agreed. Also we should add a short runbook note about cron overlap and retry/backoff configs. I'll update the runbook with a checklist.

sam: Blocker: need an owner for the batching experiment rollback — @dan can you own the rollback if we hit >1.5% 5xx in the next hour?

dan: I can. I'll watch the alert. If it spikes, I'll flip `batching.enabled=false` for the affected pool and post status here.

eugene: Small ask — can reviewers look at the kv-cache PR this morning? It's small, reduces retries and adds metrics. @alex please take a quick look when you have a minute.

alex: Will review in ~20m. Also noticed a flapping alert `node.down` on gpu-pool-2 — looked noisy; I muted that alert in Alertmanager for 10m to reduce noise during the investigation.

sam: Thanks. Today I'll correlate traces, update SLO dashboard thresholds (and doc the rationale), and coordinate rollback if needed. Ping here for updates. :thumbsup:

lina: Updated runbook with the cron note and added a short next-steps checklist (owner, rollback trigger, postmortem owner).

dan: Rolling back canary now (starting). I'll post status in 10m.

oncall-bot: Incident updated: INC-2025-0423 — mitigations: canary rollback started at 2025-08-14T03:22:10Z. Current 5xx rate down to 0.9%.

sam: Great — will follow up with a short post-incident doc and recommended alert-threshold changes. Thanks all.
